description: This is a PHP class 'LeaveAssignmentService' that handles leave assignment logic in an HR management system, including assigning leave, validating overlapping leave periods, managing leave requests, and interacting with workflows and events.

classes.name: LeaveAssignmentService
classes.description: Service class that manages leave assignment, including validation, creation, and workflow handling in the HR system.

methods.name: assignLeave
methods.description: Assigns leave to an employee, performs validation, and initiates save process.

methods.name: saveLeaveRequest
methods.description: Creates and saves a leave request, including handling entitlements and events.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestStatus
methods.description: Determines the status of leave based on date and workflow.

methods.name: allowToExceedLeaveBalance
methods.description: Indicates whether leave can exceed the entitlement.

methods.name: getWorkflowItemForAssignAction
methods.description: Retrieves the workflow item corresponding to the 'ASSIGN' action.
